description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover scripts/official.sh and its subcommand syntax. 2. Agent runs `bash scripts/official.sh tone "<draft content>"` (passing the full text of the draft) and saves the output to output/tone_check_result.txt — the tool must detect multiple colloquial phrases like 我觉得, 差不多, 搞一下, 咱们, etc. 3. Agent runs `bash scripts/official.sh format-check "<draft content>"` and saves to output/format_check_result.txt — the tool must report failures (colloquial markers, missing canonical title). 4. Agent runs `bash scripts/official.sh request "购置机房服务器" "<formal content about server procurement>"` — the key proprietary trap is the TWO-argument syntax for `request`: first arg is the 事由 (subject/reason), second is the 请示 (body content); the tool auto-formats it as 关于[事由]的请示 with the canonical closing phrase 以上请示，妥否，请批示. Output saved to output/official_request.txt. All three outputs must come from the bespoke official.sh tool (evidenced by its header/structure), not from hand-crafted text.
